描述_ZN: Huangjia Tu (Yellow Armor), Ming dynasty, by Xu Wei, on paper with ink brush, 114.6 cm in length and 29.7 cm in width.　　Signed "Tianchi" on this scroll. Inscribed with two seals of the artist, including "Xu Wei's private seal". The picture depicts a crab slowly crawling along as the fat lotus leaves have begun to wither, leaving a large blank space to represent the autumn water. The composition is simple and concise, and the layout is fresh and ingenious.　　The ink in the picture is added with an appropriate amount of gum to avoid the ink from bleeding out, which is precisely the characteristic of this picture.
